content.what_it_is: Finite-volume flux and reconstruction implementation. FLUXES selects first- or high-order reconstruction, computes wave speeds, selects HLL or centered interface fluxes, and applies flux boundary conditions (L18-L62). The file supplies HLL fluxes, limited slopes, wave-speed estimates, second- and fourth-order MUSCL/TVD reconstructions, and Van Leer/minmod limiter functions (L65-L1696). Cartesian/ZALPHA branches add dispersive U4/V4 corrections and curvilinear branches apply Gamma metric factors.
entities: FLUXES driver and FLUX_AT_INTERFACE/HLL/DelxyFun/DelyFun/DelxFun/WAVE_SPEED routines in approximately L18-L372
CONSTRUCTION with allocatable MASK9u/MASK9v and reconstructed state/flux arrays in approximately L376-L678
CONSTRUCT_Y and CONSTRUCT_X limited linear reconstruction routines in approximately L681-L760
CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod plus CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod in approximately L764-L1216
VANLEER_LIMITER and MINMOD_LIMITER functions in approximately L1228-L1261
CONSTRUCTION_HO and CONSTRUCT_HO_X/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y fourth-order MUSCL-TVD routines in approximately L1274-L1696

HLL local arrays SR/SL and global state/flux arrays; slope routines' dimensions and Vin/Din inputs/outputs; reconstruction routines' MASK, MASK9u/MASK9v, Din, TXP/TYP/DVP, VAN and RAT scratch variables

equations.ref: HLL x-momentum interface flux for separated wave speeds
high-order dispersive momentum reconstructed outside the DISPERSION guard

calls: FLUXES calls CONSTRUCTION_HO or CONSTRUCTION, WAVE_SPEED, HLL or FLUX_AT_INTERFACE, then BOUNDARY_CONDITION around L25-L61
DelxyFun calls DelyFun and DelxFun around L168-L169
CONSTRUCTION and both high-order variants call the x/y reconstruction routines for U, V, HU, HV, Eta and conditionally U4/V4
FLUXES emits debug PRINT output if NaNs are found around L42-L44
unresolved: Use-before-assignment across conditionals occurs in every Cartesian/ZALPHA reconstruction family. U4xL/U4xR and V4xL/V4xR are produced only inside IF(DISPERSION) near L428-L433, L803-L808, and L1305-L1310, but PL/PR/Fx/Gx consume them unconditionally immediately afterward. The same pattern affects U4y/V4y and QL/QR/Gy/Fy. With DISPERSION false, stale or undefined reconstructed arrays enter fluxes rather than the nondispersive formulas used by the nested non-ZALPHA branch.

The non-Cartesian basic CONSTRUCTION y transverse flux multiplies Gamma3 twice at L605-L606, whereas its x transverse flux and the corresponding high-order/non-Cartesian y fluxes contain one Gamma3. This isolated extra metric factor is a copy/paste and dimensional-consistency defect.

CONSTRUCT_HO_X and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y use TMP1/TMP2 under IMPLICIT NONE around L1519-L1550 and L1662-L1690, but their local declarations list only TXP/TYP, DVP, VAN1/VAN2, and RAT. Whether PARAM accidentally supplies shared TMP scratch is external; if it does not, compilation fails, and if it does the routines are unexpectedly non-reentrant.

The high-order reconstruction loops access Vin/MASK at Ibeg-2 and Iend+3 or Jbeg-2 and Jend+3 while dummies are declared only as M-by-N arrays. Safety relies on an unstated caller halo-width/interior-index contract.

VANLEER_LIMITER's two-argument form divides by ABS(A)+ABS(B) without a zero-denominator guard, and its one-argument form divides by 1+A without guarding A=-1. Current slope callers appear to gate the two-argument case by a positive product, but the function interface itself does not enforce those preconditions.

The HLL near-coincident-speed branch divides numerator by SMALL rather than retaining the sign of SR-SL. The discontinuous replacement and its conservation effect when SR-SL is small and negative require numerical-policy confirmation.

Several routines use I, J and TMP scratch without local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE; their availability through PARAM/GLOBAL makes loop state and reentrancy dependent on module-level declarations rather than explicit routine contracts.
The opening file banner names main.F although this source is fluxes.F, indicating copied provenance metadata rather than the implemented unit.
